description.ar: إطار يوضع فوق الصورة دون اقتطاع أي جزء منها.
description.fr: Un cadre posé sur la photo, sans rien rogner.

$comment: A frame is NOT a card. It carries no data fields: every string on it comes from brand/entities.yml, because an overlay that could be retyped per match is an overlay that will eventually go out with the competition misspelled. It renders to a transparent PNG that is laid over a photograph at exactly the photograph's size — see logos/dist/frames/README.md for what a committee member does with it.
